original_text:
Recently, one of my colleagues went through her Data Science interview at PayPal. 

So, sharing the complete experience here: 

She got the interview opportunity through a referral on LinkedIn, and so the interview started.

📍𝗥𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱 𝟭: 𝗗𝗮𝘁𝗮 𝗦𝗰𝗶𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗷𝗲𝗰𝘁𝘀 & 𝗠𝗟
In this round she was asked about one of her previous projects from scratch to finish, along with a a lot of cross-questioning around the project.

Some questions asked were:
→ How did you leverage machine learning algorithms?
→ What steps did you take to deal with dirty or missing data?
→ What techniques did you use when feature engineering?

📍𝗥𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱 𝟮: 𝗦𝗤𝗟, 𝗣𝘆𝘁𝗵𝗼𝗻 𝗖𝗼𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴, 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗕𝘂𝘀𝗶𝗻𝗲𝘀𝘀 𝗖𝗮𝘀𝗲 𝗦𝘁𝘂𝗱𝘆
The next round focused on SQL, Python coding, and a business case study. For example, she demonstrated how to aggregate and manipulate tables in SQL, build a machine-learning model in Python, and use APIs.

A scenario-based question asked how she would approach analytics in a particular domain, her thought process in solving a specific problem, etc.

📍𝗥𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱 𝟯: 𝗕𝗲𝗵𝗮𝘃𝗶𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗮𝗹 𝗜𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄
This was the final round with a senior Director, where she was asked a lot of technical data & business analytical questions.

Questions were like:
→ How well do you know natural language processing or recommendation systems?
→ Explain how you would analyze data on user behavior to look for trends or anomalies.

Overall the interview went really well for her & soon she received the job offer too. 🎉

#paypal #interviewexperience #datascience
